ctx.x: Dan Morgenstern, that's the man I was trying to think of, have written very good books, give very good discographies. Dave Baker's Jazz Book has got good discography in it. Well, most of those jazz books have good discographies and guys listen to those records very carefully, and above all, I think that music has gotten so technical, gotten so fast, so high powered, that it's gone off in this offshoot direction of what they call synthesized music, fusion music, that the only direction for the mainstream of jazz…

So I think if somebody wants to take a gamble on the future he should gamble on being more musical. And by that I mean, learning to play lyrically, whether you want to play a melody or -- whatever you play should have a melodic line and
